tmpl.helpSuffix: " for more information about a command.
root.short: Search, register, and manage domains from the terminal
root.long:
domain-cli is the command line client for RegisterDomainCLI.

It searches domain availability, places orders (register, renew, transfer),
and manages DNS records, nameservers, contacts, and billing for the
domains you own.
cli.legal.notice: By continuing you agree to the Terms of Service ({{.TermsURL}}) and the Privacy Policy ({{.PrivacyURL}}).
signup.long:
Creates a RegisterDomainCLI account.

A verification code is emailed to you; enter it to receive your API token,
which is saved to the local configuration file.
signup.codePrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from the email:
signup.discarded: The sign-in was discarded and the verification code is spent. Fix the problem above, then run `domain-cli login --email {{.Email}}` for a new code.
login.long:
Signs in to RegisterDomainCLI.

The flow is the same as signup: a verification code is emailed to you and
exchanged for your API token. The sign-in is saved, so `domain-cli account
switch` moves between accounts without another code.
logout.long:
Revokes the API token stored on this machine and forgets the sign-in.

Other machines signed in to the same account hold their own tokens and stay
signed in. To sign in again, run `domain-cli login`.
whoami.short: Print the email of the logged-in account
whoami.long: Prints the email of the currently logged-in account.
account.delete.short: Delete your account and all data
account.delete.long: Permanently deletes your account, along with your orders, invoices, contact sets, billing profile, and domain records.
account.delete.confirmPrompt:
This permanently deletes your account, orders, invoices, and domain records.
Type "DELETE" to confirm:
account.list.long: Lists the accounts saved on this machine and marks the one in use.
account.list.empty: No saved accounts. Sign in with `domain-cli login`.
account.switch.long: Makes a saved account the one every command acts as. Its stored token is checked first, so a revoked sign-in is reported instead of silently selected.
account.switch.stale: The saved sign-in for {{.Email}} is no longer valid. Run `domain-cli login --email {{.Email}}`.
account.remove.short: Revoke and forget a saved account
account.remove.long: Revokes the token stored for an account and drops it from the local list. The account itself is untouched on the server.
account.notFound: No saved account for {{.Email}}. See `domain-cli account list`.
search.long:
Searches domain availability for a keyword (e.g. "acme") or checks a
specific FQDN (e.g. "acme.example").

Prices shown are indicative one-year discovery prices; the exact charge is
always shown before you confirm an order.
search.hdr.name: NAME
search.footer: Prices are indicative one-year discovery prices; the exact charge is shown before you confirm an order.
register.long:
Registers a new domain.

Shows the exact price first and asks for confirmation before creating the
order, then opens the checkout page in your browser and waits for the
payment to complete.

Registrant precedence: an inline prompt (--own-contact) wins, then
--contact <label>, then your default contact set; if you have none, you
are prompted and offered to save the details as a contact set.
renew.long:
Renews a domain for one or more years.

Shows the exact price first and asks for confirmation before creating the
order, then opens the checkout page in your browser and waits for the
payment to complete.
transfer.long:
Transfers a domain from another registrar.

Requires the transfer (EPP) auth code from the current registrar. The
domain must be unlocked there before the transfer can start.

Shows the exact price first and asks for confirmation before creating the
order, then opens the checkout page in your browser.
order.dryRun: Dry run: no order was created.
order.checkoutOpen: Opening the checkout page in your browser...
order.polling: Waiting for the payment to complete...
order.timeout: Timed out waiting for the order to complete. Check `domain-cli orders` (order {{.ID}}).
transfer.note: Transfers can take up to 7 days to complete. Watch `domain-cli orders` for progress.
orders.long:
Lists your orders with their status, invoice number, and checkout URL.
Use --cancel to cancel an open order.
invoice.short: Open the invoice for an order
invoice.long:
Fetches the order and opens its pre-signed invoice URL in your browser.
The URL is also printed, so it can be shared or opened manually.
browser.openFailed: Could not open the browser automatically. Open this URL manually: {{.URL}}
invoice.noInvoice: No invoice is available yet for this order.
contacts.add.short: Save a new registrant contact set
contacts.add.long: Prompts for the registrant contact fields and saves them under the given label.
contacts.default.short: Mark a contact set as default
contacts.savePrompt: Save these details as a contact set? [y/N]
billing.set.long:
Prompts for every billing field and saves the profile.
The billing profile is the buyer data printed on your invoices.
billing.portal.short: Open the billing portal in your browser
billing.empty: No billing profile saved. The domain contact will be used as the billing data; add a tax ID via `billing set` if you need VAT-exempt treatment.
legal.short: Open a legal document in your browser
legal.long:
Opens one of the legal documents published by your server in your
browser and prints its URL.

Pages: notice, privacy, terms, cookies. The default is notice.
legal.badPage: Unknown page "{{.Page}}". Choose one of: notice, privacy, terms, cookies.
domains.long:
Lists the domains registered in your account with their expiry date,
autorenew, privacy, and transfer-lock state.

Use the authcode, lock, unlock, and autorenew subcommands to manage a
domain.
domains.hdr.name: NAME
domains.authcode.short: Print the transfer (EPP) auth code of a domain
domains.authcode.note: Keep this code private. The domain must be unlocked before it can be transferred out: run `domain-cli domains unlock <domain>` first.
domains.authcode.warning: This code authorises moving {{.Name}} to another registrar.
domains.unlock.warning: Unlocking {{.Name}} allows it to be transferred to another registrar.
domains.autorenew.short: Turn autorenew on or off for a domain
domains.autorenew.warning: Turning autorenew ON authorises an annual charge to your saved payment method.
dns.list.short: List the DNS records of a domain
dns.delete.short: Delete a DNS record by ID
dns.ns.short: Show or set the nameservers of a domain
dns.nsGet.short: Show the nameservers of a domain
dns.nsSet.short: Replace the nameservers of a domain
err.notLoggedIn: Not logged in. Run `domain-cli signup` first.
warn.configPerms: {{.Path}} is readable by other users (mode {{.Mode}}); the saved token is exposed. Re-run signup or chmod 600 it.
warn.tokenNotRevoked: A token this machine no longer records is still live on {{.Server}}: {{.Err}}
update.available: A new version is available: {{.Latest}} (installed: {{.Current}}). Update: curl -fsSL https://registerdomaincli.com/install.sh | sh
update.checkFailed: Could not check for a newer version: {{.Err}}
err.tokenServerMismatch: The saved token belongs to {{.StoredServer}}, not {{.Server}}. Pass --token to use it with that server.
err.badServer: The server must be an https URL (plain http is allowed only for localhost): {{.URL}}
